sections.heading: Is FP Markets Worth Your Money in 2026?
sections.body:
Nine thousand Trustpilot reviews. Ninety-four percent five-star ratings. A 4.9 out of 5 aggregate score. These are not numbers you manufacture — they represent twenty years of traders getting what they were promised. FP Markets has operated since 2005 under ASIC regulation, quietly delivering institutional-grade ECN pricing while IC Markets and Pepperstone dominated the conversation. The difference? FP Markets charges $6 round-turn on Raw. The other two charge $7. That dollar per lot, multiplied by volume, is the reason cost-obsessed traders eventually find this broker.

Ten thousand instruments. Every major platform — MT4, MT5, cTrader, TradingView. IRESS for DMA share trading if you want genuine exchange-level equity access. And a commission structure that rewards you for choosing Raw from day one. The Standard account at 1.0 pips exists but makes no sense when Raw costs less.

The limitations are relative, not absolute. No options or futures trading. The retail loss rate disclosure is broad (74-89%) rather than specific. Education trails dedicated teaching brokers. But these are weaknesses compared to Saxo Bank's 71,000 instruments — not weaknesses in any normal context. For the ECN trader who values cost, platform choice, and proven reliability above marketing polish, FP Markets is the broker the internet eventually recommends.
